title: A journey's panel: the rule, the judges and every candidate's votes
description: Picks and close calls are computed from this file by liner_notes.workflow.panel, never stored. A pick has at least rule.yes yes votes and no veto, or an override to pick. A close call is any other candidate within one vote of the rule, or vetoed. Votes in `votes` are keyed by judge id, each {vote: yes|no, why}. Vote counting and the judge ids are checked by code, since this schema can't name the keys.

public.description: Whether the votes and close-call quotes may be published. Default false: some quotes are opinions about artists.

judges.description: Keyed by a short judge id. Each has name, title and lens; veto: true lets that judge veto.

quote.description: The line the page shows for a pick. Without one, assemble uses the first yes vote's reason.
